title: How EXJET aircraft charter works
seoTitle: How to Book a Private Jet Charter with EXJET
description: Plan your charter from the first request to arrival. Compare aircraft, review a written quote, confirm the operator and coordinate the itinerary with EXJET.

sections.heading: 1. Share your itinerary
paragraphs: Start with your departure and destination airports, dates, passenger count and schedule flexibility. Add baggage, pets, accessibility requirements and any ground transportation needs. One-way, round-trip and multi-leg requests help us understand the complete mission.

sections.heading: 2. Compare suitable aircraft
paragraphs: Your EXJET advisor helps evaluate the cabin, range, baggage space, airport suitability and the operating carrier. Aircraft profiles are a starting point; an actual proposal identifies the available aircraft and its configuration.

sections.heading: 3. Review the complete proposal
paragraphs: Review the written trip total, taxes, fees, payment schedule and cancellation terms. Confirm the operator, the proposed aircraft and any substitution terms. A search result or request submission does not confirm a reservation.

sections.heading: 4. Confirm and prepare
paragraphs: Once the applicable agreement and payment requirements are complete and the booking is confirmed, coordinate passenger information and the final itinerary with your advisor. Confirm the departure facility, reporting time and contact details before travel.

sections.heading: 5. Stay connected through arrival
paragraphs: Keep your advisor informed of changes to the schedule or passenger requirements. The operating carrier determines flight safety and operational decisions. EXJET helps coordinate the customer-facing details of your journey.

title: Private aviation options: charter, leasing and ownership
seoTitle: Private Aviation Options: Charter vs Ownership | EXJET
description: Compare empty leg flights, private jet charter, dry lease, fractional ownership and whole-aircraft ownership. Find the approach that fits your travel.

sections.heading: Empty legs
paragraphs: Consider one-way repositioning opportunities when your schedule and airports are flexible. Availability depends on the underlying aircraft movement and requires confirmation.

sections.heading: Charters
paragraphs: Arrange a private flight for your route and passengers. For executive teams, events or larger groups, build the request around the full passenger and baggage brief.

sections.heading: Dry lease
paragraphs: Explore aircraft leasing around your operating needs, intended use and lease duration. Review the operating arrangements and responsibilities with your aviation advisers.

sections.heading: Fractional
paragraphs: Compare shared aircraft ownership programs against your travel history, access needs, recurring commitments and exit terms.

sections.heading: Ownership
paragraphs: Plan aircraft acquisition and ongoing ownership around your mission, budget and management requirements. Coordinate specialist review before making a commitment.

sections.heading: Business and commercial aviation support
paragraphs: For passenger or cargo capacity, technical projects and ongoing aircraft support, explore the full EXJET service offering.

title: Aircraft operator relationships
description: Connect with EXJET about aircraft charter opportunities. Discuss operating authority, aircraft capabilities, coverage and the information needed for trip review.

sections.heading: Start with your capabilities
paragraphs: EXJET welcomes introductions from certificated aircraft operators. Share your company name, operating region, aircraft categories and commercial contact through our contact page. An introduction does not imply acceptance into a network or a guaranteed volume of business.

sections.heading: Review each mission
paragraphs: Operator authority, aircraft suitability, insurance, safety information and operational requirements are reviewed for the specific request. The operating carrier retains operational control and determines whether the mission can be performed.

sections.heading: Keep information current
paragraphs: Aircraft availability, specifications, cabin configuration, commercial terms and operational contacts should be current when options are presented. Use the agreed secure channel for documents; do not submit sensitive operational records through a general inquiry.

title: Business aviation partnerships
description: Discuss business aviation collaboration with EXJET across charter, aircraft ownership and technical projects. Tell us how your services support a client mission.

sections.heading: A practical introduction
paragraphs: Tell us about your organization, capabilities and the client need you can help address. EXJET considers relationships across charter planning, aircraft ownership, maintenance coordination, interiors and connectivity.

sections.heading: Define the work before making promises
paragraphs: Scope, responsibilities, commercial terms and any client-facing representation should be agreed before a project begins. We do not publish a standard referral commission, exclusivity promise or guaranteed volume.

sections.heading: Connect with EXJET
paragraphs: Use our contact page to introduce your company and proposed collaboration. Include the relevant service and region so the conversation can reach the appropriate contact.
